entry.name: rnbo_welch~
entry.description: Processes incoming values based on the Welch windowing function, provided below... w[n] = 1 - (n - N/2 / N/2)^2 where, in this implementation, N = 1 . The Welch window thus implements a parabolic contour instead of a sinusoidal one. The function's input and output range is from 0. to 1.

arguments.name: x
arguments.description: The signal to be windowed, bounded to the range 0. - 1.
